title: BobGuard AI Policy
description: JSON Schema for the BobGuard enterprise governance policy file (.ai-policy.json).

policyVersion.description: Semantic version of the policy file.

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 date the policy was last modified (YYYY-MM-DD).

owner.description: Team or individual responsible for this policy.

security_framework.description: The security framework used to classify vulnerabilities.

banned_vulnerabilities.description: List of vulnerability names that cause a commit to be blocked.

vulnerability_patterns.description: Regex pattern arrays keyed by vulnerability type slug.

banned_licenses.description: SPDX license identifiers that are forbidden in AI-generated code.

license_patterns.description: Regex patterns to detect license headers in diff additions.

block_on_hallucinated_deps.description: If true, commits that reference non-existent packages are blocked.

package_registries.description: Registry base URLs used to verify package existence.

allowed_licenses.description: SPDX identifiers of explicitly permitted open-source licenses.

block_commit_on_failure.description: If true, a failed audit causes the pre-commit hook to exit 1.

attempt_auto_remediation.description: If true, Subagent C is invoked to generate a fix patch when violations are found.

fail_open_on_gateway_timeout.description: If true, the hook exits 0 (allows commit) when the gateway is unreachable.

gateway_timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds before the pre-commit hook times out waiting for the gateway.

audit_all_commits.description: If true, every commit is logged even if no violations are found.

hash_algorithm.description: Cryptographic hash algorithm used for the provenance seal.

hash_scope.description: What is included in the data being hashed for tamper-evidence.

track_ai_ratio.description: If true, the AI vs human line ratio is computed and stored per commit.

ai_author_tag.description: Human-readable label for the AI coding agent (e.g. IBM Bob 2.0).
